messages:
maria_product: Thanks for the all-hands! Quick follow-ups on the security/privacy section — can someone clarify the SOC2 evidence timeline, ISO scope/timing, KMS BYOK ETA for Private, and whether VPC private endpoints will be GA soon? Also curious what the default audit-log retention is. tagging @anya and @sean

anya: Short answers to start: SOC2 evidence collection is rolling now — aiming for an internal Type I readiness by end of Q2 and Type II early Q4 (dependent on evidence maturity). ISO 27001 assessment kicks off next month. KMS BYOK v1 (customer-managed keys via cloud KMS) targeted for Private in ~6–8 weeks as an early beta — Dedicated prioritized alongside. VPC private endpoints: planned GA in July. Default audit-log retention in Console is 90 days; enterprise plans can request extended retention. I'll drop the doc links below.

sean: Adding context — we're prioritizing customer-facing evidence packages (control mappings + exportable artifacts) for Dedicated/Private first. For hosted-API customers we will provide attestation docs and an audit-log export flow.

ops_liz: For customers who need >1 year retention, do we have an export API or an S3 push option already?

anya: Good Q. We have an auditlog-export API in alpha. For enterprise customers we'll enable S3 delivery (configurable in Console) — ETA aligned with BYOK beta. In the meantime we can provide on-demand exports for audits.

devx: Will there be sample playbooks for customer auditors? e.g. a control mapping matrix and instructions for evidence handoff.

anya: Yes — a sample SOC2 control matrix + evidence playbook is being prepared this sprint and will go into the compliance portal. @devx would you partner on the 'how to share logs + playbook' doc so we have example steps and screenshots?

devx: :thumbsup: Happy to help. Also, do public docs need a security review before we publish the playbook?

maria_product: One more KMS question: will BYOK v1 support HSM-backed keys or only cloud KMS import?

anya: v1 supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS (import/CMKs). HSM-backed (external HSM integration) is on the roadmap but not in the initial beta — we plan to scope HSM support after we stabilize BYOK usage patterns.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Compliance office hours this Friday 10:00am PT — join for deeper Qs and evidence requests: https://company/internal/compliance-office-hours

maria_product: Great, I'll bring the customer ask to office hours. Thanks everyone!
